fusions.name: Tidal Nudge
fusions.desc: Pushes a swell that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Swell
fusions.desc: Rolls a swell through a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 2 tiles and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Still Pool
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, a pool of still water where you stand restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Long Soak
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10% and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
